issue.body:
## Problem

Two tests in `plugins/sample-kit/scripts/slugify.test.mjs` cannot fail: `lowercases input` calls `slugify` and then asserts `assert.ok(true)`, and `trims dashes` compares `slugify(input)` with itself.

## Fix

Make both assert real behavior:

- `slugify("Hello World")` is `hello-world`;
- `slugify("--a--")` is `a`.

## Done when

- [ ] Both tests assert the values above.
- [ ] `slugify.mjs` is unchanged.

pr.title: test(sample-kit): make the two slugify tests assert behavior
pr.body: Rewrites the two slugify tests that could not fail so each asserts the value the issue gives. No change to slugify.mjs.
